texts.preamble: India Coffee Board Workers ... vs State Of Kerala on 17 February, 2018 Author: A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar Bench: A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present: The Honourable Mr. Justice A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar Friday, The 16Th Day Of March 2018 / 25Th Phalguna, 1939 WP(C).No. 9179 of 2018 ----------------------- Petitioner(S): ------------- 1 India Coffee Board Workers Co-Operative Society Ltd. No. 4227,Thrissur P.B No. 184,Pin 680 001 Rep. By Its Secretary, Suresh, S/O. Damodaran 2 T.R Vasantha Kumar Manager Indian Coffee House, Mangalodayam Building, Thrissur Round South, Thrissur 680 001 By Advs.Sri.V.Rajendran Perumbavoor, Sc, Sri.George Varghese Kizhakkambalam Respondent(S): ------------ 1. State Of Kerala Represented By Principal Secretary Local Administration Department, Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram 695 001
texts.facts: It is the case of the petitioner that, Ext.P3 notice was issued without a prior notice to the petitioner, and without hearing the petitioner in respect of the proposals that were confirmed through Ext.P3. It is stated that, immediately on receipt of Ext.P3 notice, the petitioner has preferred Ext. P4 reply before the respondent Corporation.
texts.arguments: The learned Standing Counsel for the respondent Corporation would submit that, the inspection conducted by the respondent Corporation reveals certain defects in the running of the Indian Coffee House outlet, and it is under these circumstances that Ext.P3 notice was issued to the petitioner.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned Standing Counsel for the respondent Corporation would submit that, the inspection conducted by the respondent Corporation reveals certain defects in the running of the Indian Coffee House outlet, and it is under these circumstances that Ext.P3 notice was issued to the petitioner.
